title: Saudi Real Estate Contract Types
description: Schema for validating Saudi real estate contract type entries in data/contract-types.ar.json

id.description: Unique identifier for the contract type

category.description: Primary category of the contract type

required_parties.description: List of parties required to execute the contract

must_be_registered.description: Whether the contract must be registered with a government platform

platform.description: The platform on which this contract is typically registered or managed

governing_regulation.description: The primary regulation or law governing this contract type

key_clauses.description: List of key clauses that must be included in the contract

oneOf.description: No maximum duration (e.g. for permanent transfers)

max_duration_years.description: Maximum duration of the contract in years, or null if no limit applies

notes_ar.description: Additional notes or remarks in Arabic
